{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], reheated
*2 cups uncooked farfalle [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]]

*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] fresh shredded [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmiggiano-Reggiano cheese]]
*¼ cup unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy cream]]
*4 oz (115 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) grated [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]

== Procedure ==
#In a gallon (4 liters) of boiling salted water, cook pasta to [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]].
#Drain pasta and rinse with cold water. Toss with chicken and set aside.
#Melt 2 tbsp butter in a medium [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] over medium high heat. Once bubbling ceases, add flour and cook, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisking]] continuously until mixture turns light blonde in color.
#Add remaining sauce ingredients. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] and reduce heat to low. Drizzle over pasta mixture and serve warm.
